summary: Iteration 9 testing complete. All requested features verified: (1) POST /api/orders with coordinates auto-detects zone/fee/total, (2) Driver ranking endpoints return tier/score/schedule_access, (3) Scheduling window shows tier-based access times, (4) Auto-generate emergency slots creates AUTO slots, (5) Zones map bug fixed - shows correct fees (14/22/33 lei). No regressions found in Admin/Driver/Restaurant flows.

issues: Console warnings about HTML nesting (span inside th/tr/td) - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

zones_map_bug_fix.details: Zones now show correct fees: Zona 1 = 14 lei, Zona 2 = 22 lei, Zona 3 = 33 lei. Sector filters (Toate/Nord/Centru/Sud/Nord Extrem) work correctly.

order_creation_with_zone_detection.details: POST /api/orders with customer_latitude/customer_longitude auto-calculates delivery_fee, delivery_zone_name, delivery_sector, delivery_zone_level, and total_amount

admin_ui_create_order_map.details: Admin UI shows map location picker, detects zone on click, displays fee and total

driver_ranking_me_endpoint.details: GET /api/drivers/ranking/me returns ranking_score, ranking_tier, ranking_tier_key, schedule_access for driver

drivers_list_with_ranking.details: GET /api/drivers returns ranking_score, ranking_tier, schedule_access for all drivers

scheduling_window_endpoint.details: GET /api/schedules/scheduling-window returns tier, score, opens_at, can_select_schedule for driver

driver_ui_tier_display.details: Driver UI shows tier badge (Gold/Silver/Bronze/Start), score, and calendar access time

admin_drivers_program_ranking.details: Admin Program UI shows driver ranking tier and score for each driver card

emergency_auto_generate.details: POST /api/schedules/emergency/auto-generate creates AUTO slots (35 created in test). Slots marked with created_by='system'

admin_program_auto_generate_button.details: Admin Program UI 'Generează Automat Sloturi' button works, AUTO slots appear in list with badge

no_regressions.details: Admin/Driver/Restaurant flows working correctly. Login, orders, schedules, zones all functional.

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed creates 100 orders, 5 drivers, 5 restaurants, 12 delivery zones (4 sectors × 3 zone levels)

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real. Zone polygons are manually refined approximations but fully functional and admin-editable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 features fully tested. Key features: (1) Order creation with map location picker auto-detects zone and calculates delivery fee, (2) Driver ranking system with 4 tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze/Start) and tier-based calendar access, (3) Emergency slots auto-generator creates slots based on hourly demand heuristics. All 13 backend tests pass. All UI features verified. Minor console warnings about HTML nesting in DriverSchedule component (cosmetic only).
